outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial cluster map image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual region annotation, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows H&E images and spatial expression heatmaps, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.

Panel D shows GSEA enrichment plots (running enrichment score curves with NES/FDR/p-values), which are not averages of replicate measurements but rank-based enrichment statistics computed from the full ranked gene list; there are no individual replicate data points to overlay.

Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold-change per gene derived from a single differential expression statistical test (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon rank-sum across thousands of spots) comparing Tmprss11b-high vs -low groups. Each bar represents one computed fold-change value (not a mean of a small number of biological replicates), so there are no discrete individual data points to plot; the associated p-values already convey the statistical basis.
